offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes prescription medicines for gastrointestinal diseases. Sells its drugs to patients through wholesalers and specialty pharmacies, and relies on contract manufacturers for production.

primary_products.value: prescription gastrointestinal drugs; short bowel syndrome therapy (in development)

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesalers, specialty pharmacies and distributors supplying gastroenterology patients; B2C: patients with gastrointestinal diseases, via prescription

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription GI drugs sold to wholesalers and specialty pharmacies; licensing or royalties: royalties and milestones from licensed products and partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold to wholesalers and pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: US commercial sales plus partner-licensed rights in Europe, Japan and other regions

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: drug wholesalers and specialty pharmacies; partners / resellers: licensing partners commercializing in other territories

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval and marketing regulated by FDA, EMA and other health authorities

notes: Product details are uncertain; the portfolio (linaclotide royalties, apraglutide) has changed over time.
